verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documented capability for user-defined rules that fire actions automatically when events occur, such as event triggers, rule builders, or schedules. 'Agent Flows' and 'custom agent workflows' are named only as titles, with no evidence that they run on events. The automatic meeting transcription is a fixed built-in behavior, not user-defined rules, so it is an adjacent feature and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
